title: Proxy War
description: Intercept a replacement key before it reaches the security contractor.
objective: Intercept transfer receipt at Authoritative record / Intercept transfer receipt at Live mirror
condition: All required objectives must be secured. Optional archives pay extra. Quiet bonus uses peak trace.
aftermath: Your handler’s enemies were being funded by the same continuity reserve.

lore.title: Proxy War / Unsent message
lore.text: ORIN / Directorate defector: Intercept a replacement key before it reaches the security contractor. The sender asks you to keep the names attached to the evidence; anonymous totals have concealed people before.

lore.title: Proxy War / Custody note
lore.text: Archive custody, Proxy War: Your handler’s enemies were being funded by the same continuity reserve. A second copy carries a hand-written objection to the official disposition.

lore.title: Proxy War / Private annotation
lore.text: Personal note filed under proxy-war: Your handler’s enemies were being funded by the same continuity reserve. Someone has crossed out the word inevitable. No replacement was supplied.
